# Sakura Mobile

> > Sakura Mobile provides mobile connectivity, fiber internet, and travel resources for visitors and residents in Japan.

Sakura Mobile offers comprehensive guides on Japan SIM cards, eSIM, Pocket WiFi, fiber internet services (NTT FLET'S Hikari, NURO Hikari), mobile phone plans (Rakuten Mobile), and travel information including cherry blossom viewing spots, onsen recommendations, and cultural experiences across regions like Tokyo, Kyoto, Kansai, Chubu, Kyushu, and Shikoku.

## Key Topics

- Japan SIM cards and eSIM
- Pocket WiFi rental
- Fiber internet (NTT FLET'S Hikari, NURO Hikari)
- 4G and 5G connectivity
- Rakuten Mobile plans
- Cherry blossom (sakura) viewing guides
- Onsen and hot spring recommendations
- Tokyo day trips
- Gaming lag and ping optimization
- NTT Docomo network compatibility
- Kansai and Chubu regions
- English support for foreigners
- Study abroad in Japan
- International roaming (AT&T)
- Travel data usage planning

## Mobile & Internet Services

- [How Much Data Do You Need in Japan? A Traveler's Guide](https://www.sakuramobile.jp/blog/japan-sim/how-much-data-do-you-need-during-your-trip-to-japan): Data usage estimation guide for Japan travelers using apps and maps
- [LONG TERM SIM CARD COMPATIBILITY](https://www.sakuramobile.jp/compatibility/long-term): NTT Docomo 4G/5G network compatibility and frequency band requirements
- [Rakuten Mobile SAIKYO Plan Review | Prices & Support](https://www.sakuramobile.jp/blog/japan-phone-plans/rakuten-mobile-plans): Rakuten Mobile SAIKYO Plan review with unlimited data pricing analysis
- [6 Best Pocket WiFi Rentals at Kansai Airport](https://www.sakuramobile.jp/blog/japan-pocket-wifi/kansai-airport-wifi-rental): Kansai Airport WiFi rental comparison: JAL ABC, Ninja WiFi, Global WiFi
- [Guide to AT&T International Plans in Japan](https://www.sakuramobile.jp/blog/japan-sim/guide-to-att-international-plans-in-japan): AT&T International Day Pass and roaming options for Japan travelers

- [Guide to NURO Hikari | Prices, Reviews and How to Apply](https://www.sakuramobile.jp/blog/japan-home-internet/nuro-hikari): NURO Hikari fiber internet guide with pricing and application process
- [Fiber Internet vs. Home WiFi: Choosing the Right Fit for Your Needs](https://www.sakuramobile.jp/blog/japan-home-internet/fiber-internet-vs-home-wifi-choosing-the-right-fit-for-your-needs): Fiber internet vs home WiFi comparison guide for Japan connectivity
- [Fix Game Lag in Japan: 4 Easy Solutions to Reduce Ping](https://www.sakuramobile.jp/blog/japan-home-internet/reduce-lag): Gaming lag troubleshooting guide for Japan with WiFi/LAN optimization tips
